canonical_title: PhysAg3D: Bridging 3D Generative and Agentic Models for High-Fidelity and Physically-Interactive Assets
abstract: Combines image-based mesh generation with agent-guided construction and repair of physical interactions.
screening_reason: The agent uses geometry tools and simulated interaction evidence to revise joints, parts and surface bindings.

screening_evidence.evidence: The agent inspects generated meshes, constructs physical structures, and uses rendered interactions plus execution checks to target bounded revisions.

contribution: Combines image-based mesh generation with agent-guided construction and repair of physical interactions.
limitations: Single-image physical properties are inferred; selected passages were inspected, without reproducing the experiments.

canonical_title: AdMuse: Skill-Guided Creative Advertising Image Generation
abstract: Routes reusable creative skills to advertising briefs, selects concepts, and refines generated images with visual critique.
screening_reason: A critic checks the rendered advertisement and feeds revisions back into prompt generation.

screening_evidence.evidence: Concepts compete before rendering. A critic then approves the image or requests prompt revisions; rejected attempts are summarized and the loop has a round limit.

contribution: Routes reusable creative skills to advertising briefs, selects concepts, and refines generated images with visual critique.
limitations: Evidence covers the main method; supplementary details and experimental results were not independently reproduced.

canonical_title: Inkitiate: Initiating and Steering Agent Assistance through Ink in a Spatial Workspace
abstract: Lets users steer agents with handwriting and sketches, returning reusable content and layouts to a spatial canvas.
screening_reason: Image generation and canvas organization overlap graphics authoring; the broader system primarily supports knowledge work.

screening_evidence.evidence: Ink requests bind canvas objects and agent capabilities. The prototype supports image generation and canvas organization; agent outputs remain editable and reusable.

contribution: Lets users steer agents with handwriting and sketches, returning reusable content and layouts to a spatial canvas.
limitations: Scope-dependent: resource retrieval and knowledge work alone are outside the graphics-authoring focus.

canonical_title: Video Generation Meets Agent Harness: Agentic Video Generation, Agentic World Modeling and Recursive Self-Improvement
abstract: Discusses agent harnesses for video production, interactive world models and recursive improvement.
screening_reason: A directly relevant synthesis of graphics-related agent runtimes, rather than a new implemented authoring system.

screening_evidence.evidence: The report examines harness-managed tools, context, state, feedback and budgets across video generation, world modeling and recursive improvement.

contribution: Discusses agent harnesses for video production, interactive world models and recursive improvement.
limitations: Review/report; no single system taxonomy or empirical improvement is inferred from its overview.

canonical_title: DIP-CAD: A Design-Intent-Preserving Agent Harness for Parametric CAD Modeling
abstract: Uses explicit geometry references and sketch constraints to preserve parametric CAD design intent.
screening_reason: VLM-guided modeling commands and sketches interact with CAD geometry and solver checks.

screening_evidence.evidence: The VLM predicts commands from tagged model views and geometry tables; sketch primitives are mapped into CAD coordinates and constraints are validated by the solver.

contribution: Uses explicit geometry references and sketch constraints to preserve parametric CAD design intent.
limitations: Already in the library under the earlier title Vision2CAD. This record captures the verified v3 title and timing; version-to-version changes were not audited.
